description: This file defines the ProtonClient class, which is a client for interacting with the AWS Proton service. It extends AwsClient and includes method annotations for various API operations related to AWS Proton, such as creating, deleting, and retrieving resources and configurations.

classes.name: ProtonClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Proton service, providing methods for resource management and service operations.

methods.name: acceptEnvironmentAccountConnection
methods.description: Accepts a request to connect an environment account in AWS Proton.

methods.name: cancelComponentDeployment
methods.description: Cancels a component deployment in AWS Proton.

methods.name: createComponent
methods.description: Creates a new component in AWS Proton.

methods.name: createEnvironment
methods.description: Creates a new environment in AWS Proton.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific environment.

methods.name: listEnvironments
methods.description: Lists all environments in AWS Proton.
